CITY OF SAN MARINO

  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA

Peter Wong, Chair  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Christa Lakon, Vice Chair  (626) 300-0711 Phone

  MEETING OF THE SAN MARINO
  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 18, 2022 AT 7:00 P.M.
  VIA TELECONFERENCE

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Design
Review Committee with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every month at 7:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
Community Development Department via email at planning@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone
at (626) 300-0700 prior to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the Design Review Committee may teleconference into the meeting without noticing
each teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
To protect staff, our constituents, and city officials, members of the public must follow the State
and County Health Department’s current Health Officer Orders, which require wearing a mask
indoors. Given the seriousness of COVID-19, you are encouraged to watch or listen to the
meeting from home, or provide input electronically, if you do not feel comfortable attending in
person.

Members of the public may observe and offer comment at this meeting telephonically or
otherwise electronically:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to planning@cityofsanmarino.org before or
  during the meeting, prior to the close of public comment on an item, to be read during
  public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time.
 DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA – May 18, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 5

  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION, please contact the Community Development Department
at (626) 300-0700. A copy of the staff reports under review at this Design Review Committee
meeting will be available for public review by the end of the day on April 1, 2022 on the City’s
website at: www.cityofsanmarino.org

How to participate in the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming/Zoom Meeting
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89152778564
  Meeting ID: 891 5277 8564
  Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 891 5277 8564

  2) Submitting Public Comment
  Submit public comments via email to planning@cityofsanmarino.org. Members of
  the public participating via the Zoom web app may select the raise hand function
  prior to the close of public comment on an item. Members of the public joining
  via telephone audio can select the raise hand function by dialing *9 on the
  telephone dial pad.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Chair Peter Wong, Vice Chair Christa Lakon, Committee Member
  Raymond Cheng, Committee Member Joyce Gatsoulis-Batnij, Committee
  Member Sharon Mequet, Alternate Committee Member Tony Chou, and
  Alternate Committee Member Rick Chou

POSTING OF AGENDA
This meeting agenda is being posted 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations:
City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The meeting agenda is also posted on the City’s
website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS
The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review
Committee on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Design
Review Committee. Pursuant to state law, the Design Review Committee may not discuss or
take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2).

STAFF UPDATES
 DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA – May 18, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 5

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

1. DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR 21-63
  2174 MELVILLE DRIVE (CHEN & PAN/ TYLER)
  The applicant proposes to construct a 1,150 square-foot two-story addition to an existing
  2,088 square-foot, two-story, single-family residence, demolish the existing garage and a
  construct new 536 square-foot detached two-car garage. The proposed project will include
  changes to the front façade to restore a balcony behind the front facade, a new clay tile roof
  on the new portions, replacement or relocation of windows and doors, alteration of
  pavement to the existing driveway, installation of new perimeter fencing in the side yard,
  installation of a new wrought iron gate in the side yard, new landscaping and exterior finishes.
  The project is situated on a 11,700 square-foot interior lot in the R-1 zone, Area District V.
  The project requires Design Review pursuant to City Code Section 23.15.03. The Design
  Review project was previously heard at the Design Review Committee meeting on April 6,
  2022.
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Design Review Committee: 1) determine that
  the project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to
  State CEQA Guidelines, Article 19, Section 15331, Class 31, and that there is no substantial
  evidence demonstrating that an exception to a categorical exemption pursuant to State
  CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; 2) find that the proposed first and second story
  addition is compatible with the legal neighborhood and the existing structure itself; and 3)
  approve the project with the added condition that the property owner shall implement the
  tree protection guidelines contained in the consulting arborist report dated March 2022;
  that Trees 6, 7, and 8 be subject to removal at the discretion of the City’s Urban Forester,
  with replacement trees to be added to the property at the satisfaction of the Urban Forester
  and City Code requirements..
2. DESIGN REVIEW CASE NOS. DRC 21-50
  2131 SOUTH OAK KNOLL AVENUE (ZHANG/CHANG)
  The applicants propose to replace existing motorized driveway gates with new gates not to
  exceed five feet six inches in height and less than 25% opaque, and make changes to the
  associated pilasters not exceeding six feet in height, on a property improved with a two-story
  residence located in the R-1 zone, Area District II. The project requires Design Review
  pursuant to City Code Section 23.15.03 F. The Design Review Project was previously heard
  at the Design Review Committee meeting on January 5, 2022.
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Design Review Committee 1) determine that
  the proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Article 19, Section 15301, Class 1, and that there is no
  substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a categorical exemption pursuant to
  CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies; 2) find that the proposed motorized gates and
  exterior changes to the pilasters are compatible with the residence and similar accessory
  structures on the Block; and 3) approve the proposed project.
 DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA – May 18, 2022  PAGE 4 OF 5

3. DESIGN REVIEW CASE NOS. DRC 21-72
  2046 S OAK KNOLL AVENUE, (LO)
  The applicants propose to replace wrought iron on an existing front yard fence and add a
  new wrought iron security gate to the main porch entrance of the residence on a property
  improved with a two-story residence located in the R-1 zone, Area District II. No changes to
  the existing driveway gate, pedestrian gate, pilaster or walls in size or location are proposed.
  The project requires two Design Review actions pursuant to City Code Sections 23.15.03. F.
  &I
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Design Review Committee 1) determine that
  the proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Article 19, Section 15301, Class 1, and that there is no
  substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a categorical exemption pursuant to
  CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies; 2) find that the proposed decorative iron gate
  feature at the main entrance and the proposed wrought iron changes to the front yard fence
  are compatible with the residence and 3) approve the project.
4. DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR 22-02
  1714 HILLIARD DRIVE, (CHUA/ LANSFORD)
  The applicant proposes to remove wood shake and install CertainTeed Presidential Shake TL
  composition shingle roofing material in the Country Grey on an existing approximately 2,335
  square-foot, two-story, single-family residence with a detached garage and pool house on a
  7,466 square-foot lot in the R-1 Zone, District VII. The proposed color and material are found
  on the City’s Pre-Approved Roofing Materials, Colors, and Applications List; however, the
  project does not meet the prerequisite of having composition shingle roofing material
  currently installed on the home and is therefore subject to design review. The project
  requires one Design Review action pursuant to City Code Section 23.15.03 E.
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Design Review Committee: 1) determine that
  based on the whole of the administrative record, that the proposed addition is exempt from
  CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1, and that there is no
  substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to
  CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; 2) find that the proposed project is compatible
  with the legal Neighborhood and with the existing structure itself; and 3) approve the project
  with added condition that the conditions for composition shingle roofing material listed on
  the City’s Pre-Approved Roof Materials, Colors, and Applications List shall be applied.
5. DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR 22-05
  2205 EL MOLINO DRIVE, (PATTISON)
  The applicant proposes to remove concrete tiles and install CertainTeed Presidential Shake
  TL composition shingle roofing material in the Charcoal Black color on an existing
  approximately 3,073 square-foot, two-story, single-family residence with a detached garage
  on a 11,426 square-foot lot in the R-1 Zone, District VII. The proposed material is found on
  the City’s Pre-Approved Roofing Materials, Colors, and Applications List; however, the color
  Charcoal Black is not, and the project does not meet the prerequisite of having composition
  shingle roofing material currently installed on the home. The project requires one Design
  Review action pursuant to City Code Section 23.15.03. E.
 DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE AGENDA – May 18, 2022  PAGE 5 OF 5

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the Design Review Committee: 1) Determine that
  based on the whole of the administrative record, that the proposed addition is exempt from
  CEQA pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1, and that there is no
  substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical exemption pursuant to
  CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; 2) find that the proposed project is compatible
  with the legal Neighborhood and with the existing structure itself; and 3) approve the project
  with added condition that the conditions for composition shingle roofing material listed on
  the City’s Pre-Approved Roofing Materials, Colors, and Applications List shall be applied.

  PRESENTATION

6. TRAINING ON ADVISORY BODY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  OTHER MATTERS

PUBLIC COMMENTS

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the Design Review
Committee received by Committee Members. All public writings distributed by the City to at
least a majority of the Committee Members regarding any item on this agenda will be made
available at the public counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino,
California.

APPEALS

There is a fifteen day appeal period for all applications. All appeals should be filed with the City
Clerk. Please contact the City Clerk for further information.

ADJOURNMENT

The San Marino Design Review Committee will adjourn to June 1, 2022 AT 7:00 P.M.

  ISIDRO FIGUEROA
 Posted: MAY 13, 2022  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR
